title: Pseudohypoparathyroidism Masterclass & Practice Test Bank
description: 整合 Pseudohypoparathyroidism (PHP-1a, PHP-1b, PHP-1c, PHP-2, PPHP) 臨床表型、GNAS 基因銘印機制、Ellsworth-Howard 測試與 Calcitriol 安全治療之完整主題講堂。

sections.title: Module 1: Pathophysiology & GNAS Genomic Imprinting Mechanism (PHP-1a vs PPHP)
sections.content:
### 1. Dynamic Receptor Mapping Matrix

| Tissue / Organ | Allele Expression Pattern | GNAS Loss-of-Maternal Transmission | GNAS Loss-of-Paternal Transmission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Proximal Convoluted Tubule | Monoallelic (Maternal active, Paternal silenced) | Severe PTH Resistance (PHP-1a: Hypocalcemia, Hyperphosphatemia, High Intact PTH) | Normal Endocrine Responsiveness (PPHP: Normal Calcium, Phosphate, Intact PTH) |
| Thyroid Gland | Monoallelic (Maternal active, Paternal silenced) |PHP-1a |PPHP |
|Ovaries / Testes | Monoallelic (Maternal active, Paternal silenced) | Mild Resistance to LH &Hypogonadism |PPHP |
| Skeletal System & Subcutaneous Tissue | Biallelic (Both Maternal & Paternal active) | Albright Hereditary Osteodystrophy (AHO: Short Stature, Brachydactyly, Obesity) | Albright Hereditary Osteodystrophy (AHO: Somatic Features Present) |

### 2. High-Yield Differential Comparison Table

| Feature |PHP-1a |PPHP |PHP-1b |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Molecular Mechanism | Heterozygous Loss-of-Function Mutation in Coding Exons of GNAS | Heterozygous Loss-of-Function Mutation in Coding Exons of GNAS |STX16 Deletion |
| Inheritance Pattern | Maternal Transmission | Paternal Transmission | Autosomal Dominant or Sporadic Epigenetic Defect |
| Endocrine Resistance | PTH, TSH, LH/FSH Resistance Present |Normal Hormone Responsiveness |TSH Mild or Absent |
| AHO Phenotype | Present (Short Stature, Round Face, Brachydactyly IV/V) |Identical Somatic Features to PHP-1a |Normal Somatic Phenotype |
| Erythrocyte Gsα Activity | Reduced (~50% Reduction) | Reduced (~50% Reduction) | Normal |

### 3. Pathophysiological Decision Tree

Heterozygous GNAS Mutation ➔ Maternal Transmission ➔ Proximal Convoluted Tubule Paternal Allele Silenced via Promoter Methylation ➔ Total Loss of Functional Gsα Subunit in Renal Proximal Tubule ➔ Defective Coupling of PTH1R to Adenylyl Cyclase ➔ Failure to Produce cAMP & Phosphorylate NaPi-IIa Transporters ➔ Reduced Urinary cAMP & Phosphate Excretion ➔ Hypocalcemia & Hyperphosphatemia +PHP-1a.

Heterozygous GNAS Mutation ➔ Paternal Transmission ➔ Active Maternal Allele in Proximal Convoluted Tubule Expresses Wild-type Gsα ➔ Preserved Renal PTH & TSH Signaling ➔ Normal Calcium & Phosphate Homeostasis ➔PPHP.

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**: 誤認為 PHP-1a 與 PPHP 是源於完全不同基因位置的基因缺陷所致。
**Analysis**: PHP-1a 與 PPHP 在同一個家族中常被發現並存（如母女或父子關係）。其根本原因在於相同的 GNAS 失能突變，其表型完全取決於 Parent-of-Origin Transmission。母源傳遞因 Proximal Convoluted Tubule 中的 Paternal Allele 被 Genomic Imprinting 沉寂，導致腎臟 Gsα 缺失而引發 PHP-1a；父源傳遞則因腎小管中未被沉寂的 Maternal Allele 繼續表達正常 Gsα，僅在 Biallelic Expressed 的骨骼組織展現 AHO 表型，即 PPHP。

**Trap**: 將 PHP-1a 與 PHP-1b 的臨床表現與基因機轉混為一談。
**Analysis**: PHP-1a 為 GNAS Coding Region 突變且伴隨明顯的 AHO 體徵；而 PHP-1b 主要是 STX16 微缺失導致 GNAS A/B Loss of Imprinting，其臨床特點為孤立性 Renal PTH Resistance，完全不具備 AHO 骨骼特徵。

sections.title: Module 2: Subtype Classification & Ellsworth-Howard PTH Stimulation Test
sections.content:
### 1. Subtype Classification Matrix

| Subtype | GNAS Gene Defect | Gsα Protein Level | Urinary cAMP Response to Exogenous PTH | Urinary Phosphate Response to Exogenous PTH | AHO Somatic Phenotype |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| PHP-1a |Maternal | Reduced (~50%) | Blunted or Absent | Blunted or Absent | Present |
| PHP-1b |STX16 | Normal in non-imprinted tissues | Blunted or Absent in Kidney | Blunted or Absent | Absent |
| PHP-1c |Maternal |Catalytic site intact | Blunted or Absent | Blunted or Absent | Present |
| PHP-2 | Post-receptor Signaling Defect | Normal |cAMP rises appropriately | Blunted or Absent | Absent |

### 2. High-Yield Differential Comparison Table

| Diagnostic Parameter | Ellsworth-Howard Test in PHP-1a | Ellsworth-Howard Test in PHP-2 | Ellsworth-Howard Test in Hypoparathyroidism |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Baseline Intact PTH | Markedly Elevated | Elevated | Low or Undetectable |
| Post-PTH Urinary cAMP Excretion | Blunted / No Increase (< 1 µmol/g Creatinine) | Marked Increase (> 10-fold rise) | Marked Increase (> 10-fold rise) |
| Post-PTH Urinary Phosphate Excretion | Blunted / No Increase | Blunted / No Increase |Phosphaturic response preserved |
| Underlying Defect | Failure of Gsα / Adenylyl Cyclase Activation | Impaired Signal Transduction Downstream of cAMP | Lack of Endogenous PTH Secretion |

### 3. Pathophysiological Decision Tree

Administration of Exogenous Teriparatide /Ellsworth-Howard Test ➔ Collect Timed Urine Samples for cAMP & Phosphate Measurement.

Urinary cAMP Fails to Rise ➔ Receptors or Gsα Coupling Failure ➔ Check AHO Phenotype ➔ If AHO Present: Evaluate Erythrocyte Gsα Activity (Reduced = PHP-1a; Normal = PHP-1c). If AHO Absent: Epigenetic STX16 Analysis for PHP-1b.

Urinary cAMP Rises Markedly (> 10-fold) BUT Urinary Phosphate Excretion Fails to Increase ➔ Normal Gsα & Adenylyl Cyclase Function BUT Post-Protein Kinase A or NaPi-IIa Defect ➔PHP-2.

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**: 盲目判定「凡是 PTH 阻抗患者，其外源性 PTH Ellsworth-Howard Test 均不會產生 Urinary cAMP」。
**Analysis**: 此為常見考題死角！在 PHP-2 中，PTH1R 與 Gsα 蛋白的結合以及 Adenylyl Cyclase 的催化作用完全正常，因此外源性 PTH 能誘發 Urinary cAMP 呈數十倍暴升；然而因 cAMP 下游的 Protein Kinase A 或 NaPi-IIa 磷酸鹽轉運體訊號傳遞阻斷，導致 Urinary Phosphate Excretion 無法相應增加。這是區分 PHP-1 與 PHP-2 最關鍵的生理測試依據。

**Trap**: 誤將 PHP-1c 視為 Gsα 完全未受影響的獨立疾病。
**Analysis**: PHP-1c 患者具有典型的 AHO 外觀與 Multiple Hormone Resistance。其特異之處在於 Gsα 的 Receptor-Coupling Region 發生突變，使 Gsα 無法被 PTH1R 激活，但在體外實驗中其 Catalytic Domain 仍可被 Fluoride 激活，故細胞層面顯示 Gsα 活性正常，本質上仍為 GNAS 突變引起之 PHP-1 變體。

sections.title: Module 3: Clinical Presentation, Multihormone Resistance & Calcitriol Safety Protocol
sections.content:
### 1. Dynamic Endocrine Resistance Matrix

| Hormone Axis | Receptor & Coupling Protein | Target Organ Phenotype in PHP-1a | Clinical & Laboratory Signs |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
|PTH | PTH1R + Gsα | Proximal Convoluted Tubule Resistance | Hypocalcemia, Hyperphosphatemia, High Intact PTH, Basal Ganglia Calcification |
| Thyroid-TSH | TSHR + Gsα | Thyroid Follicular Cell Resistance | Elevated Serum TSH with Normal/Low-Subclinical Hypothyroidism |
|LH / FSH | LHR / FSHR + Gsα | Ovarian / Testicular Resistance | Primary Amenorrhea, Oligomenorrhea, Cryptorchidism, Hypogonadism |
|GHRH | GHRHR + Gsα | Anterior Pituitary Resistance | GHRH Resistance contributing to Short Stature in AHO |

### 2. High-Yield Therapeutic Target Comparison Table

| Clinical Parameter | Target Management Level in PHP-1a | Rationale & Safety Boundary | Risks of Overtreatment |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Serum Total Calcium | Low-Normal Range (8.0 - 8.5 mg/dL) | Safely prevents neuromuscular symptoms & tetany while minimizing hypercalciuria | Nephrocalcinosis, Nephrolithiasis, Chronic Kidney Disease |
| Serum Phosphate | Near Normal Range (< 4.5 - 5.0 mg/dL) | Prevent Calcium-Phosphate Product deposition (> 55 mg²/dL²) | Soft Tissue & Vascular Calcification, Basal Ganglia Basal Calcification |
| 24-Hour Urinary Calcium Excretion | < 4 mg/kg/day (or < 300 mg/day) | Avoid overcoming distal reabsorptive threshold when PTH resistance is present | Medullary Nephrocalcinosis, Tubulointerstitial Fibrosis |
| Serum Intact PTH | Moderately Elevated (1.5 - 2x ULN) | Complete suppression of PTH is unnecessary and risks severe hypercalciuria |if suppressed, Overtreatment toxicity |

### 3. Pathophysiological Decision Tree

Diagnosis of PHP-1a ➔ Initiate Calcitriol (1,OH₂D₃) + Oral Calcium Carbonate / Calcium Citrate ➔ Bypass Impaired Renal 1-alpha-hydroxylase Activation ➔ Promote Intestinal Calcium & Phosphate Absorption ➔ Elevate Serum Ionized Calcium ➔ Relieve Paresthesias, Carpopedal Spasm & Seizures.

Long-term Safety Monitoring ➔ Measure Serum Calcium & 24-Hour Urine Calcium Excretion Every 3-6 Months ➔ If Urine Calcium > 4 mg/kg/day or Nephrocalcinosis Detected on Renal Ultrasound ➔ Reduce Calcitriol / Calcium Dosage + Consider Hydrochlorothiazide Therapy to Enhance Distal Tubular Calcium Reabsorption.

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**: 盲目追求將 PHP-1a 9.5-10.5 mg/dL。
**Analysis**: Distal Convoluted Tubule 對 PTH 的鈣重吸收作用在部分 PHP 患者中仍有殘存回應，但 Proximal Tubule 磷排泄與 1-alpha-hydroxylase 活性嚴重大跌。若過度給予高劑量 Calcitriol 與 Calcium 補劑以拉Hypercalcemia，會迅速超越遠端小管重吸收極限，誘發極度嚴重的Hypercalciuria 與 Medullary Nephrocalcinosis，導致不可逆的腎功能衰退。8.0-8.5 mg/dL 的安全目標。

**Trap**: 將 PHP-1a 患者高 TSH 的現象誤診為 Primary Autoimmune Hypothyroidism 並使用高劑量 Levothyroxine 治療。
**Analysis**: PHP-1a 中的 TSH Resistance Subclinical Hypothyroidism，Anti-TPO / Anti-TG。應謹慎從小劑量 Levothyroxine 開始調整，防止過度補充引起心律不整與骨質流失。

sections.title: Module 4: Differential Diagnosis Matrix of Hypocalcemic & PTH Resistance Disorders
sections.content:
### 1. Comprehensive Differential Diagnostic Matrix

| Disease Entity | Serum Calcium | Serum Phosphate | Intact PTH | Urinary Calcium Excretion | Distinctive Clinical & Genetic Features |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
|PHP-1a | Low | High |High | Low | AHO Phenotype Present, GNAS Maternal Loss-of-Function Mutation, Multihormone Resistance |
|PPHP | Normal | Normal | Normal | Normal | AHO Phenotype Present, GNAS Paternal Loss-of-Function Mutation, No Endocrine Defect |
| Primary Hypoparathyroidism | Low | High | Low or Undetectable | Low | Post-surgical or Autoimmune Destruction of Parathyroid Glands, No AHO, No PTH Resistance |
|ADH Type 1 | Low | High | Low or Low-Normal |Severe Hypercalciuria | Activating Mutation of CaSR, Absence of AHO, Severe Hypercalciuria Risk with Calcium Treatment |
|VDDR-1A | Low | Low or Normal |High | Low |1-alpha-hydroxylase Deficiency, Rickets / Osteomalacia Present, Normal GNAS |

### 2. High-Yield Key Distinctions Table

| Feature |PHP-1a |ADH | Primary Hypoparathyroidism |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Primary Pathophysiologic Defect | GNAS Mutation ➔ Target Organ PTH Resistance | CaSR Activating Mutation ➔ Suppressed Parathyroid & Kidney CaSR threshold | Parathyroid Gland Destruction / Aplasia ➔ Inadequate PTH Synthesis |
| Intact PTH Level |Secondary Hyperparathyroidism | Low or Inappropriately Low-Normal | Undetectable or Very Low |
| Risk of Nephrocalcinosis with Calcium Therapy |Controlled at Low-Normal Serum Ca |Calcium supplementation massively drives urine Ca |Controlled at Low-Normal Serum Ca |
| Family History / Phenotype | AHO Features; Parent-of-Origin Transmission | Familial Hypocalcemia with Mild / Asymptomatic Course | Autoimmune Polyendocrine Syndrome Type 1 or Surgical History |

### 3. Pathophysiological Decision Tree

Patient Presents with Hypocalcemia & Hyperphosphatemia ➔ Check Serum Intact PTH Level.

Intact PTH is Low or Inappropriately Low-Normal ➔ Evaluate 24-Hour Urine Calcium Excretion ➔ If Urine Calcium is Low:Surgical/Autoimmune. If Urine Calcium is High / Hypercalciuric: Suspect Autosomal Dominant Hypocalcemia (ADH: Gain-of-Function CaSR Mutation).High ➔ End-Organ PTH Resistance or Vitamin D Defect ➔ Check Serum Phosphate & Alkaline Phosphatase ➔ If Phosphate Low/Normal & ALP High: Vitamin D Deficiency / Rickets. If Phosphate High & ALP Normal/Mildly Elevated:PHP.

PHP Confirmed ➔AHO ➔ If AHO Present: Measure Erythrocyte GsαPHP-1a. If AHO Absent:PHP-1b.

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**: 誤將 Autosomal Dominant Hypocalcemia (ADH, CaSR Gain-of-Function Mutation) 診斷為 Primary Hypoparathyroidism 並給予大量 Calcitriol 與 Calcium。
**Analysis**: ADH 是因 Calcium-CaSR 發生 Gain-of-Function 突變，TALH 誤以為血鈣過高，從而壓低 PTH 分泌並大幅增加尿鈣排泄。若誤用 Calcitriol 與 Calcium 治療，患者會出現極度暴增的Hypercalciuria與Acute or Chronic Renal Failure！這是與 PHP-1a 以及 Primary Hypoparathyroidism 最危險的臨床鑑別診斷點。

**Trap**:FHH 與 ADH 的分化方向。
**Analysis**: FHH 為 CaSR Loss-of-Function 突變，表型為Hypercalcemia and Hypocalciuria與正常/偏高 PTH；而 ADH 則為 CaSR Gain-of-Function 突變，表型為Hypocalcemia and Hypercalciuria與低/正常 PTH。兩者機轉正好相反，臨床死角必須精確掌握。
